verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists a PPT assistant with template selection and smart layout, and Agent-built webpages with deploy/share and multi-turn modification, which shows file creation with iterative editing. Kimi Code's agent also edits local files through conversation. All of this evidence is one-line help-center titles or coding-oriented docs, with no detail on document creation or export formats. Missing for 10: explicit document (e.g., Word/report) creation, documented export/download formats for presentations and files, iterative editing of presentations specifically, hands-on or independent corroboration.
